home.title: See how in sync you are
home.subtitle: Upload your couple chat history and discover the story, rhythms and numbers of the two of you.

privacy.title: Privacy comes first
privacy.p2: No message ever leaves your device.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: In the chat: ⋮ menu → More → Export chat → Without media. Upload the .txt or .zip file.

telegram.title: Telegram Desktop
telegram.body: On desktop: ⋮ menu → Export chat history → JSON format. Upload the result.json file.

consent.label: I have the other person's permission to analyze this chat.
consent.hint: Check this to enable file upload.

drop.idle: Drag files here or tap to choose
drop.disabled: Check the consent above to upload files

home.demo: See a demo with fictional data

confirm.title: Confirm who is who
confirm.why: Each app stores names differently. Confirming the pairs avoids counting the same person twice.
confirm.ignore: Not part of the couple / ignore
confirm.demoNote: Example with fictional names. Real detection will come from the Worker.

timeline.title: Your story
timeline.subtitle: Use the arrow keys or drag to browse the milestones.
timeline.firstDetail: One of your first times together.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Tap a card to see the details.

stories.title: Story cards
stories.body: 9:16 images with numbers only, no messages.

prompt.title: Copy prompt for AI
prompt.body: The text carries only numbers and dates, never messages. Paste it into any AI chat.
prompt.dictionary: Include the couple's dictionary (nicknames and words only you use)
prompt.error: Could not copy. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete everything
delete.body: Removes files and results from this tab's memory.
delete.confirmBody: You go back to the start and will need to upload the files again.
